creator.title: SCUTOONS Creator
creator.sign_in_text: Sign in with your email to open the creator editor.
creator.no_access_text: The creator editor is for SCUTOONS creators. Your account ({email}) doesn't have the creator role yet – ask an admin to add it.
creator.new_chapter_created: Chapter {number} created as a draft in every locale and added to the season. Save it to keep it.
creator.publish_confirm: Publish {file} ({locales})? Readers see it right away.
creator.leave_confirm: You have unsaved changes. Leave anyway?
creator.restore_confirm: Restore version #{id} as a new draft of {locale}?
creator.recover_stale: They were made on an older version.
creator.conflict: Someone saved a newer version of {locale} ({file}). Reload to get it, or overwrite it with yours.
creator.status_hint: Visibility in the reader, per language: published = listed and readable, draft = hidden, coming-soon = listed but not readable. Stored in {file} and saved with the chapter.
creator.status_not_in_season: not in the season (invalid – every chapter belongs to a season)
creator.status_sync: The chapter file's status follows the season on save.
creator.status_follow_chapters: Saving also updates the status in the chapter files (for older readers).
creator.season_missing: This toon has no season yet. Create season 1 (and toon.json if it is missing) as drafts in every language, then add chapters.
creator.orphans: Chapter files without a season: {numbers}. A chapter must always belong to a season – add them to {file}.
creator.not_loaded: The toon's files are not loaded yet. Reload the page and try again.
creator.chapters_adopted: Existing chapter files added to the season as draft: {numbers}.
creator.same_for_all_hint: Use the {locale} value in every language
creator.toon_missing: This toon has no toon.json yet – create season 1 on the toon page (it creates toon.json too).
creator.reader_uses_season: The reader shows the season title and description (plot) on the toon page, and the sequence status decides which chapters are listed / readable. Not shown anywhere in the reader yet: authors, number, release, language, cover (square/portrait) and credits – the credits page shows the toon's Credits (the Credits page) in the reader's language.
creator.reader_uses_toon: The reader shows title, description and cover.square on the toon page, map (terrain layer, size, center) in the map overlay, download.music / download.complete and title on the download page. Not used by the reader: id, authors, chapters, language, release, thumbnail, cover.portrait and status (listing uses the toon's index entry).
creator.format_hint: SCUTOONS slice: 390×625 px at 1x, 1170×1875 px at 3x – text-free art, the words are live text boxes.
creator.draw_hint: Drag on the image to draw a text box. Arrows nudge, Shift+arrows ×10, Delete removes.
creator.select_slice: Select a slice on the left.
creator.languages_hint: The source language is the one the toon is written in; the others are translations of it. Every editor of this toon (text boxes, missing translations, length warnings, VN events, new chapters) follows these settings.
creator.languages_unsaved: Save the draft to use the new languages in the editors.
creator.languages_remove_note: Removing a language keeps its files in the store; the editors just stop showing it.
creator.locale_files_created: {count} {locale} files created from {source} as drafts (not published).
creator.preview_hint: Newest drafts from the store, rendered like in the reader.
creator.preview_vn_note: Visual novel events are not played in the preview.
creator.preview_renderer_note: Horizontal groups are shown one below the other here.
creator.credits_open_hint: People and their roles – shown on the reader's credits page
creator.credits_deprecated: Moved to Credits – these season fields are no longer edited here and the reader never showed them. Edit the credits on the toon's Credits page.
creator.credits_move_hint: Drag, or focus and press ArrowUp / ArrowDown
creator.credits_lead_hint: Shown first and prominently on the credits page.
creator.credits_entries: Credits (grouped by role category on the page)
creator.credits_people_hint: {count} people in the shared registry (all toons).
creator.credits_merge_confirm: Merge “{from}” into “{to}”? {count} references in this toon are replaced; the name becomes an alias.
creator.credits_registry_hint: The registry is shared by every toon: changes show up in all credits after publishing.
creator.credits_custom_roles_hint: Only this toon uses them (saved in its credits.json).
creator.credits_vocabulary_hint: The role vocabulary of all toons (scutoons/_/roles.json).
creator.cast_empty: No characters in this toon's cast yet.
creator.cast_hint: Who appears in each season of this toon, with which personas, in order, each with a role per language. Characters live in the shared registry (all toons) – a character with its own toon can join other casts too.
creator.cast_open_hint: The toon's characters – used by the VN scenes
creator.characters_available: file on the CDN, path not set
creator.characters_convention_all: also where the file is missing
creator.characters_convention_hint: Convention for new images (from the CDN root): {path}. Empty cells show (faded) what the reader shows instead: the look's neutral – for an empty look the default look – then the single image.
creator.characters_empty_registry: The registry is not in the store yet – “New character” starts it.
creator.characters_expression_counts: {set} set · {found} ✓ · {missing} ✗ · {available} on the CDN, not set
creator.characters_home_hint: Every character of every toon: names, personas, looks, moods, A-poses
creator.characters_inherits: Name, color, voice and own toon come from the base unless set here.
creator.characters_looks_hint: One look. “Add look” adds another outfit (e.g. with helmet) with its own mood set.
creator.characters_no_toon: No toon (no cast, no own toon)
creator.characters_pick: Pick a character on the left, or create a new one.
creator.characters_remove_look_confirm: Remove the look “{look}” and its image paths?
creator.characters_remove_personas: Its {count} personas stay and become invalid.
creator.characters_remove_used: It is in the cast of {toons}.
creator.characters_look_empty: This look has no images yet
creator.characters_look_empty_note: “{look}” has no images yet – until they are set, the reader shows the default look (mood, else neutral), then the single image.
creator.characters_glossary: Persona, look, mood, view – what is what?
creator.characters_glossary_persona: A different identity or role of the same being (Cat Pope · human, · cat, · Biker) – it changes who they are in the story. Every character has the persona “regular”.
creator.characters_glossary_look: The appearance right now: outfit, gear, accessories – it can change within a scene (helmet on/off). Rule of thumb: if it could come off in the next panel, it's a look; if it changes who they are in the story, it's a persona. One default look per persona.
creator.characters_glossary_mood: The expression. The vocabulary is open (Moods tab); only neutral is required – the standard set is a checklist.
creator.characters_glossary_view: The framing: only the portrait is drawn; the avatar is a 192px copy of it, full is not used. In the data still called “variant”. The A-pose (avatar body for members) belongs to the character, not to a persona.
creator.characters_glossary_fallback: When an image is missing, the reader steps back one step at a time (other views first use the portrait): persona + look + mood → same look neutral → persona's default look + mood → its neutral → regular persona's default look + mood → its neutral → the single image.
creator.characters_apose_anchors_hint: Where the inventory places items on this body (centre x/y and size in px of the image). Outfitting happens in the reader's inventory.
creator.characters_apose_hint: The character's avatar body for members (character level – the persona doesn't matter). Full body, neutral, 768 × 1152.
creator.characters_apose_start: Add the standard A-pose looks (swim pants, naked)
creator.characters_avatar_derived: The avatar is a 192px downscale of the portrait (generated)
creator.characters_glossary_character: The being in the SCUTOONS universe (an own toon is optional). Name, description, color, voice, tags, artwork and the A-pose belong here.
creator.characters_moods_hint: Every mood of every character: add as many as you like, name them per language, order them. ★ standard marks the checklist a look should cover – never required, only neutral is (the fallback anchor).
creator.characters_no_transitions: No transitions. A transition is an image shown while the look changes (e.g. taking the helmet off).
creator.characters_note_hint: Creates an asset request for {file} – listed under “Wanted images”. Scenes keep working with the fallback.
creator.characters_nothing_wanted: Nothing wanted – every standard mood has an image.
creator.characters_path_missing_hint: Not on the CDN yet – the path can be saved anyway (upload the file with cdn/sync.py).
creator.characters_picker_all_moods: show every mood of the vocabulary
creator.characters_picker_will_add: not in the cast of {season} – picking adds it
creator.characters_remove_mood_confirm: Remove the mood “{mood}” from the vocabulary? {count} looks have an image for it (the images stay).
creator.characters_remove_persona_confirm: Remove the persona “{persona}” with its looks?
creator.characters_wanted_hint: Missing portraits of the standard set, missing A-poses and every note – with the file name the image should get. Copy the list to brief the image supplier. (Interim until images can be uploaded to the CDN from the creator.)
creator.characters_persona_color: Color of the persona (else the character's)
creator.characters_groups_hint: Shared groups across toons (a gang, a family, a band …). Characters join them on their detail page (Groups / affiliations).
creator.characters_no_groups: No groups yet – add one in the Groups tab.
creator.characters_remove_group_confirm: Remove the group “{name}”? {count} characters still reference it.
